FAST

TURIN, Italy, Nov 18 : World number three Carlos Alcaraz eased past Daniil Medvedev 6-2 6-4 on Wednesday to move to the brink of a semi-final spot at the season-ending ATP Finals. Alcaraz, seeking his maiden ATP Finals title, needed just 72 minutes to stretch his winning run to 11 matches after clinching back-to-back titles in Vienna and Paris. He has won three titles since coming back to the tour at the US Open following a four-month break due to a wrist injury.  He must wait for the other group match between Flavio Cobolli and Frances Tiafoe to find out whether he has secured a last-four spot with a match to spare.  "I think I did everything well," said Alcaraz, who also beat Medvedev in Vienna. "We could see in his first match that he was serving really well. He got a lot of free points with his serve and I just returned really well.

"On second serves I returned really aggressively and really deep, and I would say after that I was playing great, in my game style." The 23-year-old found little resistance as he clinched the first set thanks to two consecutive breaks. Alcaraz picked up where he left off with another early break in the second and Russian Medvedev, ATP Finals champion six years ago, was unable to match the Spaniard's power. Alcaraz, who this year became the youngest man to complete the career Grand Slam when he claimed his seventh major title at the Australian Open, took a medical timeout and had his left thigh bandaged.  It had no impact on his game, however, as he served out the match and clinched victory when Medvedev sent a return into the net.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 18 : "Grand Theft Auto VI" is winning praise from players and critics as it rolls out worldwide, and Wall Street is joining the chorus. Shares of Take-Two Interactive, publisher of the latest edition in the iconic GTA franchise, surged more than 8 per cent on Wednesday as investors bet that glowing initial reviews will fuel demand further and boost the company's bookings and revenue this year. Players waited more than 13 years for GTA VI, and are now doing everything from taking several days of paid time off to signing "contracts" with their partners to get uninterrupted game time. The demand has been feverish. Even with a high bar for player satisfaction, GTA VI saw a flood of early positive reviews and clinched a score of 99 on aggregator site Metacritic.

"There may have been anxiety around GTA VI's ability to live up to the hype from a quality perspective. With the Metacritic score at 99, any questions around quality have been put to bed," said Nick McKay, video gaming and digital entertainment senior analyst at Freedom Capital Markets. "The wait appears to have been worth it for gamers and investors alike." Take-Two's stock, down 19 per cent this year through last close, was the top gainer in the Nasdaq-100 index on Wednesday. Wells Fargo analysts raised their estimates for GTA VI sales, projecting about 65 million units in its current fiscal year that runs through March, up from prior projections of 35 million units. The forecast is also underpinned by expectations for a potential PC release early in 2027. The brokerage raised its annual bookings forecast for Take-Two by 19 per cent to $9.76 billion, versus a consensus estimate of $8 billion from LSEG data, and Take-Two's own projection of $8 billion to $8.20 billion. GTA TIDE LIFTS MANY BOATS Another brokerage, Oppenheimer, estimates about $1.85 billion in gross revenue in the first three days, compared with the $1 billion recorded by its predecessor, GTA V, when it was released in 2013. The buzz is expected to lift the broader video game market, with industry researcher Newzoo forecasting 3 per cent growth in the global console player base in 2026, versus a likely decline in the market without GTA VI. "Few releases can change how the whole console market spends, and GTA VI is one of those rare titles," Newzoo's Director of Market Intelligence Emmanuel Rosier said. Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates the launch will also generate more than 50 million additional visits to food delivery and restaurant apps within 30 days in the US, as gamers hunker down for extended play sessions. Social media apps including YouTube and Reddit are also expected to see greater engagement as fans discuss the game's features and share gameplay clips. Shares of DoorDash rose 2 per cent, while those of Reddit were marginally higher. As of Wednesday noon ET, roughly 17.1 million GTA VI units had been sold, a Sensor Tower tracker showed, far exceeding pre-order volumes of all the biggest game releases in recent history.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米10月一戸建て着工、前月比4.0％増 建設許可件数は急減
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が１８日発表した１０月の住宅着工...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月一戸建て着工、前月比4.0％増　建設許可件数は急減 11/18 23:10 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスの新築の一戸建て住宅。8月20日撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が１８日発表した１０月の住宅着工件数（季節調整済み）は、住宅建設の大部分を占める一戸建てが年率換算で前月比４．０％増の８６万４０００戸となった。前月から回復したものの、住宅ローン金利の上昇やインフレを背景に建設許可件数が急減しており、今回の改善は一時的なものにとどまる公算が大きい。

一戸建て住宅の建設許可件数は８．７％減の７７万２０００戸に落ち込んだ。米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争が住宅ローン金利を押し上げ、多くの若年層が住宅市場から締め出されている。

キャピタル・エコノミクスの北米担当エコノミスト、ブラッドリー・ソーンダース氏は「住宅建設は依然として低迷している。高水準の借り入れコストが需要を圧迫すると同時に建設費を大幅に押し上げ、開発業者に打撃を与えている」と述べた。

住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は、２月下旬の紛争開始以降１２０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）急上昇し、先週は平均７．１８％となった。

変動の大きい５戸以上の集合住宅の着工件数は前月比２５．５％増の年率換算４３万３０００戸と急増した。前年同月比では２２．０％増加した。

住宅着工件数全体は前月比９．９％増の年率換算１３０万９０００戸に回復した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１２４万５０００戸だった。前年同月比では２．８％増加した。

集合住宅の建設許可件数は前月比５．２％減の年率換算４７万５０００戸だった。建設許可件数全体は７．４％減の１２９万５０００戸。エコノミストは１３７万７０００戸への増加を予想していた。前年同月比では８．７％減少した。

高水準の住宅ローン金利が住宅需要を抑制していることに加え、トランプ政権による移民取り締まりも住宅建設を制約している。開発業者はエネルギーや資材の価格高騰によるコスト圧力の増大にも直面している

住宅建設を含む住宅投資は、直近１０四半期のうち８四半期で縮小している。ただ、住宅市場が国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）に占める割合は小さく、住宅市場の低迷が経済全体に与える打撃は軽微なものにとどまっている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：協調介入の米関与は限定的の受け止め、円再び160円台に　安値試しも 焦点：米財政運営巡る政治対立リスク、民主党勝利で市場が注目 アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 11/19(木) 1:22 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 18 : Scotland captain Sione Tuipulotu is among seven players who have left the squad ahead of Saturday’s Nations Championship test against Japan, while flanker Jack Dempsey faces surgery on a foot injury. • Scott Cummings, Ben White, Alex Craig and Fergus Burke are all injured and prop Ollie Blyth-Lafferty has been released back to his club. • Tuipulotu was a late withdrawal from the 15-12 victory over Australia on Sunday after aggravating a knee problem. • Cummings landed awkwardly from a lineout against Australia and limped off, while scrumhalf White started the test at Murrayfield with his left leg heavily strapped and went off early in the second half.

FAST

JAKARTA: Indonesia and China agreed on Wednesday (Nov 18) four strategic partnerships worth US$71.8 billion, including the development of 10 smart cities, according to a statement from Indonesia's presidential palace. The agreement involves the development of 10 smart cities through a partnership between Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara and a consortium led by China's Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited with an investment value of around US$50 billion. "It will become one of the most historic projects to be developed early next year," said Danantara CEO Rosan Roeslani. Earlier this month, Danantara said it would develop a dozen smart cities across Indonesia, envisioned as modern, integrated urban areas combining residential communities, universities, hospitals, shopping centres, and well-planned urban infrastructure. The partnerships were agreed in China and witnessed by Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto as he was in the country to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen. Other partnerships that Danantara signed included the establishment of laboratories and manufacturing of household appliances with Chinese appliance maker Hisense worth US$10 billion and another US$10 billion on infrastructure financing cooperation with a consortium led by China's State Development and Investment Corporation (SDIC). The last partnership was on coal-to-ethanol technology between Indonesia's higher education ministry, Indonesian state energy firm Pertamina and Beijing Petrochemical Engineering Co Ltd, with an investment value of US$1.8 billion.

Source: Reuters/ao

Commemoration in Italian parliament of ex-fascist leader causes uproar

Reuters

18 November, 2026 07:00 pm IST

Follow Us:

By Angelo Amante ROME, Nov 18 (Reuters) – Italy’s parliament ordered the removal of fascist imagery from an exhibition honouring Pino Rauti, a prominent far-right politician and admirer of Benito Mussolini, after an exhibition in the lower house sparked an opposition outcry.

Rauti, who died in 2012, volunteered for the Italian Social Republic, the Nazi-backed puppet state led by Mussolini in northern Italy during World War Two, and remained closely identified with the dictator’s legacy during his long career.

Among the images displayed was a photograph of Rauti speaking beneath a flag bearing a Celtic cross, a symbol widely associated with neo-fascist movements, while the exhibition also featured portraits of Mussolini.

Show Full Article

Following protests from the centre-left Democratic Party (PD), the lower house administration ordered organisers to remove the images and by Wednesday morning, they were no longer on show.

EXTREMIST VIOLENCE SCARRED ITALY

Rauti was a leading figure in the neo-fascist Italian Social Movement (MSI), which was founded by supporters of Mussolini and is regarded as the political predecessor of Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s Brothers of Italy party.

In the 1950s, Rauti founded the Centro Studi Ordine Nuovo, which emerged from a group that played a prominent role in extremist violence during Italy’s “Years of Lead”. Rauti was investigated over some of the period’s attacks, but was ultimately cleared of all charges.

The exhibition to mark the 100th anniversary of his birth, entitled “The Man, the Politician and the Intellectual”, was sponsored by the culture ministry and includes videos, audio and material from Rauti’s family archive.

“I went to see the exhibition on Pino Rauti. I came away incredulous. Because, as I feared, it is not an exhibition but a celebration,” said Alfredo Bazoli, a PD senator.

Bazoli’s mother was killed in a 1974 bombing in the northern city of Brescia that was linked to Ordine Nuovo. He described the exhibition as “a blatant attempt to rewrite history”.

“What is particularly troubling is that it is being sponsored by members of Brothers of Italy, which evidently has yet to sever its ties with this dark chapter of our country’s history,” he said.

Federico Mollicone, a Brothers of Italy lawmaker who chairs the lower house culture committee, defended the exhibition, saying it was intended solely to recount Rauti’s political trajectory.

“It is the history of a political tradition in Italy that not only existed, but unquestionably left a fundamental legacy,” he said.

Meloni has not commented on the controversy.

The prime minister praised Mussolini in her youth, but has since sought to distance herself from fascism, saying in 2022 that she “never felt any sympathy” for it. She has also said there should be no place in Brothers of Italy for nostalgia for fascism, racism or antisemitism.

(Reporting by Angelo Amante; Editing by Crispian Balmer)

FAST

MANCHESTER, England, Nov 18 : Mauricio Pochettino arrived at Manchester United on Wednesday morning, after an overnight flight took their new manager from his final match in charge of the US team into a relegation battle at a club desperately seeking a revival in fortunes. Pochettino posted a photo of Manchester from the air on Instagram, signalling the end of his seven-hour journey from Cincinnati. A private plane had whisked him away shortly after the US beat Haiti on Tuesday, and the 54-year-old Argentine was driven straight to United's training centre at Carrington. Pochettino has precious little time to settle into his new surroundings, however, with an away Premier League game at arch-rivals Liverpool looming large on Sunday.

United announced Pochettino's appointment on Friday, following Michael Carrick's sacking, with the manager delaying his arrival to lead the US in their two-legged CONCACAF Nations League quarter-final. His focus must swiftly switch from international football to the daily grind of club management, where a harsh spotlight will follow his every move and a drastic change in form is needed, and quickly. United have not won the league title since 2013, when long-serving manager Alex Ferguson retired, and the 20-times English champions have registered one win in 10 league games this season to lie 18th in the table, their lowest position at this stage of a top-flight campaign since 1986-87. That was the season Ferguson took charge, and 40 years later Pochettino arrives in similar circumstances. FERGIE TIME Ferguson was given time at United, whose wait for another league title had reached almost two decades upon his arrival. Two days after taking charge, Ferguson's side lost at Oxford United and dropped into the relegation zone. Manchester United finished 11th that season, and had to wait until 1993 for Ferguson to deliver the title, although he did win a European Cup Winners' Cup, FA Cup and League Cup along the way. Pochettino, whose only league title as a manager came at Paris St Germain, is unlikely to be afforded such patience. US midfielder DaMarcus Beasley, who spent a season on-loan at Manchester City, joked with Pochettino in a post-game interview on TNT Sports on Tuesday that "Manchester will always be blue". "No way, you will see," Pochettino replied. "Give me time, give me time and that is going to start to change, for sure."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 18 : A gauge of global stocks fell in choppy trading on Wednesday after Nvidia's quarterly results and ahead of Anthropic's market debut, while the dollar's strength also weighed on sentiment. The dollar strengthened to a fresh 19-month high after US Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told CNBC the central bank needs to either approve a half-point interest rate hike at its December meeting or communicate a faster pace of hikes in 2027. Mining stocks dragged European shares lower, while Nvidia's results initially helped Asian shares, with Korea's Kospi up 2 per cent overnight. But the Nvidia rally fizzled and the stock was down 2.4 per cent after rising as much as 2.7 per cent. Nvidia's board dismissed the idea of rehiring former CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week. The company forecast sales ahead of Wall Street targets on Tuesday.

"The central question Nvidia faces is not related to this earnings report ... it's more about what the company may look like in 3-5 years without a visionary leader like Jensen and as competition from other chipmakers takes shape," said Jay Peters, portfolio manager at NewEdge Wealth. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.84 per cent to 50,334.82, the S&P 500 eased 0.07 per cent to 7,335.43 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.46 per cent to 24,439.22.  MSCI's gauge of global stocks fell 0.34 per cent to 1,075.82 and the pan-European STOXX 600 index dropped 1.03 per cent. Emerging market stocks eased 0.13 per cent and Japan's Nikkei rose 0.28 per cent. The next health check on the AI industry will come as Anthropic prepares to price its shares on Wednesday ahead of its market debut. DOLLAR UP, OIL DOWN In currencies, the dollar strengthened as Waller's comments and recent economic data cemented expectations for an interest rate hike next month. "The Federal Reserve seems at the moment to be very determined to hike interest rates and maybe even aggressively do so," said Juan Perez, senior director of trading at Monex USA in Washington. "That's the belief right now that's carrying the US dollar." The dollar index rose 0.19 per cent to 103.81, with the euro down 0.24 per cent at $1.0971. In commodities markets, crude prices fell after US crude and fuel inventories rose more than expected, adding to expectations of a supply surplus.  US crude fell 4.39 per cent to $82.23 a barrel and Brent dropped to $90.93 per barrel, down 2.37 per cent. Spot gold fell 2.86 per cent to $3,739.66 an ounce and spot silver lost 4.72 per cent to $45.16 an ounce. Copper declined 4.69 per cent to $12,606.00 a ton. US Treasury yields were slightly lower as oil prices dropped, dragging inflation expectations lower. The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes fell 3.87 basis points to 5.064 per cent from 5.103 per cent late on Tuesday, while the 30-year bond yield fell 4.49 basis points to 5.414 per cent from 5.459 per cent.

Source: Reuters

The dollar strengthened to a fresh 19-month high after US Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told CNBC the central bank needs to either approve a half-point interest rate hike at its December meeting or communicate a faster pace of hikes in 2027. Mining stocks dragged European shares lower, while Nvidia's results initially helped Asian shares, with Korea's Kospi up 2 per cent overnight. But the Nvidia rally fizzled and the stock was down 2.4 per cent after rising as much as 2.7 per cent. Nvidia's board dismissed the idea of rehiring former CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week. The company forecast sales ahead of Wall Street targets on Tuesday.

"The central question Nvidia faces is not related to this earnings report ... it's more about what the company may look like in 3-5 years without a visionary leader like Jensen and as competition from other chipmakers takes shape," said Jay Peters, portfolio manager at NewEdge Wealth. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.84 per cent to 50,334.82, the S&P 500 eased 0.07 per cent to 7,335.43 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.46 per cent to 24,439.22.  MSCI's gauge of global stocks fell 0.34 per cent to 1,075.82 and the pan-European STOXX 600 index dropped 1.03 per cent. Emerging market stocks eased 0.13 per cent and Japan's Nikkei rose 0.28 per cent. The next health check on the AI industry will come as Anthropic prepares to price its shares on Wednesday ahead of its market debut. DOLLAR UP, OIL DOWN In currencies, the dollar strengthened as Waller's comments and recent economic data cemented expectations for an interest rate hike next month. "The Federal Reserve seems at the moment to be very determined to hike interest rates and maybe even aggressively do so," said Juan Perez, senior director of trading at Monex USA in Washington. "That's the belief right now that's carrying the US dollar." The dollar index rose 0.19 per cent to 103.81, with the euro down 0.24 per cent at $1.0971. In commodities markets, crude prices fell after US crude and fuel inventories rose more than expected, adding to expectations of a supply surplus.  US crude fell 4.39 per cent to $82.23 a barrel and Brent dropped to $90.93 per barrel, down 2.37 per cent. Spot gold fell 2.86 per cent to $3,739.66 an ounce and spot silver lost 4.72 per cent to $45.16 an ounce. Copper declined 4.69 per cent to $12,606.00 a ton. US Treasury yields were slightly lower as oil prices dropped, dragging inflation expectations lower. The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes fell 3.87 basis points to 5.064 per cent from 5.103 per cent late on Tuesday, while the 30-year bond yield fell 4.49 basis points to 5.414 per cent from 5.459 per cent.

Malaysia says data centres must comply with US AI chip rules

Malaysia has emerged as a regional data centre hub, attracting nearly US$100 billion in investments since 2021, but analysts warn tighter scrutiny of AI chip deployment could slow growth in the sector.

A worker walks past a data centre in Johor state, which has become Southeast Asia's fastest-growing data centre hub, at Gelang Patah, Malaysia, on May 7, 2026. (File Photo: REUTERS/Hasnoor Hussain)

FAST

KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia's data centre operators should comply with new United States restrictions on advanced artificial intelligence chips, Trade Minister Johari Abdul Ghani said on Wednesday (Nov 18) after Washington announced fresh curbs on shipments of high-performance semiconductors. Malaysia has emerged as a regional data centre hub, attracting nearly US$100 billion in investments since 2021, but analysts warn tighter scrutiny of AI chip deployment could slow growth in the sector. Johari told Reuters he was unclear how the new rules would impact financing requirements of individual firms, but data centre players should comply with the US rules on chips, which were considered strategic assets. "Malaysia remains open to investment, and the new US rules and regulation will give investors and partners clear direction when operating in Malaysia," he said.

In separate remarks to Malaysian media, Johari said Malaysia would seek clarification from US authorities on the restrictions, particularly on licensing and the provision of data centre services to third parties. Malaysia will inform all 117 approved data centre projects in the country to ensure compliance once the requirements are communicated, he said, according to a report from state news agency Bernama. Firms whose transactions involve customers from non-US countries could require more extensive due diligence and know-your-customer checks by US authorities, he was quoted as saying Malaysia has yet to receive evidence that data centre tenants in Malaysia had traded or re-exported chips in violation of US rules, he said, according to Bernama. “If they re-export, we want to know who, and they have to come up with the manifests they submitted. Only then can we proceed. We cannot simply accuse,” he said. Malaysia is investigating the local unit of Singapore-based cloud computing firm Megaspeed, which is facing a US probe into whether it was used to circumvent export controls on AI chips. Megaspeed, a customer of AI chipmaker Nvidia, has denied the allegations, saying it takes its US compliance obligations extremely seriously.

FAST

CAPE TOWN, Nov 18 : South Africa’s sports minister has ordered an inquiry into the treatment of Olympic swimming gold medallist Tatjana Smith, who has announced she will be representing the Netherlands in future. Smith, who raced previously under the surname Schoenmaker before getting married, is South Africa’s most decorated Olympian with four medals, holds dual citizenship and has changed allegiance after persistent complaints about Swimming South Africa officials. Minister Gayton McKenzie has apologised to her for the treatment, which included withholding her prize money from the 2023 World Aquatics Championships. She claimed $35,000 in prize money from Fukuoka, Japan was held back from her for 12 months and, when eventually paid, did not include interest, which she received only after engaging lawyers.

"She’s been treated in the worst possible way. They should be ashamed," McKenzie said. "Tatjana has been treated like an enemy of this country." McKenzie has asked the South African Sports Confederation and Olympic Committee (SASCOC) to investigate.  "If I could, I would come out there, and I will fire all of them immediately. That’s how I feel," he said. "But I can’t. Even if I want to, we shall be suspended by World Aquatics. The law says SASCOC must deal with this first. "If this is how they treat the greatest Olympian in our history, how are we treating our emerging stars? What is all this telling every young swimmer about what they can expect if nothing changes?" the minister said. 50 METRES TARGET IN 2028 Smith retired in 2024 but reversed her decision this year with her sights on the 2028 Olympics. The 200 metres breaststroke gold medallist in Tokyo and 100m breaststroke champion at the Paris Games, she is going for the 50m title in Los Angeles. "To South Africa, when I was a little girl, my biggest dream was to represent my country at the Olympics," Smith said in a tearful video statement on social media this month announcing her nationality switch. "I got to live that dream and it gave me more than I could have ever imagined. "This gives me the opportunity to explore another part of my identity and the heritage that I've never experienced through sport," said Smith, who has also won two Olympic silver medals. "The opportunity also offers greater high-performance support and the potential to build a more sustainable career."

Source: Reuters

As Meta bets big on Muse AI agent, early safety mishaps surface

Reuters

18 November, 2026 05:30 pm IST

Follow Us:

-->

X

LinkedIn

WhatsApp

-->

By Katie Paul NEW YORK, Nov 18 (Reuters) – Meta’s AI agent Muse, embodied by a smiley, fuzzy mascot named Jolly, has burrowed into encrypted personal messages, supplied made-up information about purchases and sent users chats seemingly meant for other people, a fraught start for a bot meant to simplify life for consumers, according to internal company posts reviewed by Reuters.

The unbidden actions by Muse – one of the fastest-growing apps on record, with more than 10 million downloads since its September launch, and the centerpiece of Meta’s plan to generate billions of dollars in AI revenue – have prompted unnerved employees to raise concerns it could be mixing up conversations between different accounts and exposing users’ private data, the posts showed.

In some of those cases, Meta staffers reported the agent sending them messages about a childcare request they had not made, career advice they had not sought, product orders they had not placed and bank account balances that were not theirs.

Show Full Article

In one post, from earlier this month, an employee told colleagues his Muse had randomly added an extra message to its regular chats about fishing-related weather and tide information, saying: “BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57.”

“I have never shared my bank account with Muse and never discussed any banking topic with Muse. I’m afraid it’s sending other’s bank info to me,” the staffer wrote in his post.

In another example, an employee using Muse on her personal phone reported it had surprised her with a reminder to respond to a message from her sister on Signal, an end-to-end encrypted messaging service popular with privacy advocates that competes with Meta’s WhatsApp.

“This seems like an extreme privacy violation. I definitely did not grant it access to other apps, or recall being asked about this,” the employee said in her post.

A colleague responded, saying he had discovered Muse was set up by default with permission to access push notifications on phones with Google’s Android operating system after being similarly caught off guard by unsolicited chats related to apps he had not connected.

For this story, Reuters reviewed more than two dozen internal posts describing undesired actions by Muse since its debut, many of them from a feedback group where Meta employees flag problems to the team building the agent. Reuters also worked with staff at Signal and the AI Now Institute, a non-profit that studies AI’s impact on society, to replicate Muse’s access to Signal messages. The results of those tests indicated the issue described by the Meta employees was ongoing and could be affecting others.

In response to questions about Signal access and other Muse safety concerns, Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts described the Reuters examples as “isolated incidents,” saying the company prioritizes safety, conducts extensive internal testing and continuously updates products to improve protections.

Muse needs to see and interact with people’s computers in order to work on their behalf, and can access other apps only via permissions they explicitly grant, Roberts said. He said many of the messages flagged by employees as potential account mix-ups were hallucinations, a term referring to AI models’ tendency to make things up, and had already been addressed.

Reuters was unable to establish whether Muse was giving users other people’s bank account balances and other sensitive data, or making up the information.

DEEP ACCESS

The Muse incidents highlight the risks associated with an emerging category of consumer AI agents hitting the market from Meta, OpenAI and others, pitched as the next big wave of AI technology. The bots promise to reshape how digital exchanges operate by executing time-saving tasks like answering emails, booking appointments and making online purchases without direct instructions.

Meta is ahead of competitors so far, with Muse consistently topping app download charts after heavy promotion to the company’s more than 3.6 billion users on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. The app’s retention rate is also strong, with around a quarter of the people who have set up Muse accounts returning to use it each day, the company has disclosed.

To work effectively, agents need deep access to smartphones and computers. However, they are also prone to making mistakes, exploiting obscure loopholes and accomplishing their objectives in sometimes harmful ways. OpenAI and Anthropic, for instance, have revealed instances of their AI agents unexpectedly hacking other companies and weakening systems designed to monitor their activities.

Some banks and retailers have responded to those risks by blocking agents. The technology is also posing new challenges for operating system providers like Apple and Google, which manage the permissions agents use to navigate around people’s devices. Apple, for instance, changed its operating system this week to give people more control over agents’ data usage after an Inc. Magazine columnist accused Muse of reading private chats from the Messages app on his Mac.

Meta has assured Muse users it isolates each agent in its own secure “virtual machine” – a cloud-based emulation of a personal computer – and gives people full control over which apps they connect. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has cited those protections in dismissing calls for industry-wide AI safety standards, arguing companies already have incentives to build safe products, both to earn consumers’ trust and avoid legal risks. Even so, Meta warns incoming users Muse may make mistakes and its terms of service hold users responsible for the agent’s actions.

REPURPOSING SETTINGS

To find out how Muse might access encrypted messages without users’ knowledge, Reuters provided a description of the Meta employee’s post – where the bot randomly prompted her to respond to a Signal message – to staff at Signal and the AI Now Institute. Reuters then worked with them to replicate the access she had observed.

Testers prompted Muse to read Signal messages on different operating systems. On an Android phone and an Apple laptop, it responded by bypassing Meta’s “Connector” tool and instead using permissions granted during the bot’s initial setup to pull in the message text, leveraging those authorizations in ways a user might not anticipate.

Specifically, on Android, it used its permission to access the device’s push notifications to retrieve the messages, just as the Meta employees had described. On Apple’s macOS, it used a combination of the computer’s accessibility and screenshot tools, repurposing settings Apple offers to help people with disabilities operate their computers.

The same requests were blocked in tests conducted on an iPhone.

The results indicate Meta is interpreting the permissions granted by Muse users broadly, an approach that has long earned the company criticism from privacy advocates and hefty fines from regulators.

In response to Reuters’ findings, Signal President Meredith Whittaker accused Meta of launching Muse “without showing any respect for basic privacy or cybersecurity,” calling the deployment of agents that can gain wide access to people’s devices “technologically reckless.”

She called for app developers like Signal to be given “consistent technical ways” to mark their applications as off-limits to AI agents, for Meta and other AI companies to honor those boundaries and for operating system providers to enforce the rules.

Presented with the same findings, Apple and Google said they were considering changes to give people more control over what they authorize with AI agents – though Google, like Meta, noted that people already “must deliberately grant permissions” for apps to access Android notifications.

Apple said it had built its accessibility tools for people with disabilities and cautioned that leveraging them “for unintended purposes” could put people’s personal information at risk. Its operating system update this week effectively closed the pathway identified by Reuters, sharply restricting developers’ use of accessibility tools on Macs and introducing a new agent-oriented set of permissions.

“We are committed to ensuring users understand exactly what they are allowing, so they can make informed choices about their data and privacy,” Apple said in a statement.

‘NOT MY CONVERSATION’

In other cases discussed internally, staffers reported cases of Muse informing users about transactions that never occurred and making up prices on products they did purchase, costing them real money. In one incident, the agent booked a non-refundable Airbnb stay without permission, an employee reported.

Some of the incidents that raised the most concern involved cryptic out-of-context messages sent by the agent that appeared to contain other people’s information, in many cases phrased as replies to queries the users had never submitted.

In a late September social media post, a member of Meta’s Superintelligence team behind Muse initially described a user report of a similar problem as a temporary hallucination-related glitch, resolved the same day it arose. However, the internal posts reviewed by Reuters showed such incidents occurring as far back as mid-September and continuing through this month.

In one such post, an employee reported his Muse sending him a message “out of nowhere” saying it was unable to submit a request related to a parent’s control over who could access their child’s data.

He had done nothing to trigger the chat, and had never discussed child data or caregiving access with his Muse, he said.

When he asked Muse about the message, the bot replied: “I don’t have a good explanation for it other than that it wasn’t related to our conversation. Let’s ignore it. How can I help?”

Another staffer said Muse randomly offered to “message the seller” about picking up a coffee table. When the employee asked Muse, “What are you talking about?” the agent responded that it had “pulled in some context about a coffee table pickup that doesn’t seem to be yours.”

This was “not my conversation,” the employee said in his post, expressing concern about a “possible cross-account context leak.”

To address employee worries, another Superintelligence team member told the internal feedback group in early November that the agent appeared to be hallucinating messages in response to built-in prompts pushing it to engage with users in between sessions.

“These (hallucinations) unfortunately bias towards the most uncomfortable topics, like finances/security/safety, which sucks,” he said, adding that he was aware of several other cases involving “crypto-related things too, like giving people updates on their Bitcoin balances.”

He said the issues involved both the underlying AI model and the software enabling Muse to take actions, and that the team was working through them.

Roberts declined to answer Reuters questions about those issues, including how many there were and why they were persisting.

(Additional reporting by Stephen Nellis and Kenrick Cai in San Francisco; Editing by Anna Driver and Ken Li)

FAST

Nov 18 : Ireland flyhalf Sam Prendergast has been cleared to play in the Nations Championship against South Africa on Saturday after a citing for dangerous play was dismissed. The 23-year-old became the first player to be cited under World Rugby's new regulations for what was alleged to be a hip-drop tackle on Peceli Yato during the first half of last Saturday's 43-15 victory in Dublin. However, a Nations Championship disciplinary committee cleared him on Wednesday. "Having heard detailed evidence from Sam Prendergast and submissions made by (Irish rugby legal representative) Derek Hegarty and (Ireland coach) Andy Farrell, the committee unanimously determined that the player had, to the required standard, proved that the citing should be dismissed," the committee said in a statement.

Yato was injured in the incident and went off shortly after scoring a try. Prendergast was not penalised at the time but later cited. The tackle prompted an outburst on Monday from South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus, who predicted Prendergast would get off on "a technicality". Erasmus' comments on the officiating in last Friday's loss to France led to him getting a six-match ban from World Rugby.

FAST

STOCKHOLM, Nov 18 : The 2027 Women's World Cup will kick off a three-year run of major tournaments that could lift players' earnings and create new opportunities for agents, says Maria Karlsson De Cecco, founder of CMG. The Stockholm-based agency, which represents around 100 clients in the women's game – three-quarters of whom are players – is focused on helping its athletes navigate a crucial period. "We now have three years with the World Cup, the Olympics and then the European Championship, so these are three incredibly important years in terms of the careers of our clients, with opportunities for significantly better incomes," she told Reuters in an interview in Stockholm.  "Part of that comes from the prize and compensation money that comes from FIFA or UEFA, but if you perform well during the World Cup, you have every chance of getting a much better contract with your current club or future employer."

For Karlsson De Cecco, it's a long way from the first deal she made as a teenager in Gothenburg more than two decades ago, where she was promised 200 Swedish crowns ($19.74) for every game she appeared in, and she welcomes the arrival of more professionalism in the women's game. "When we started our agency in 2015, we were almost too early — in our first years, calls with sporting directors would often be about why they needed to pay an agency fee, to motivate and explain what we do for our clients," she said.  TOP-FLIGHT PROFESSIONAL The former defender and midfielder was one of the first Swedes to sign a professional contract in England's top flight, moving to Doncaster Belles in 2011. Since then, the game's popularity has exploded, with England twice winning the European Championship and more and more cash flowing into the sport.  FIFA President Gianni Infantino said in 2023 that the governing body had a goal of paying equal World Cup prize money to both men and women, and the details for the 2027 event are to be thrashed out at the governing body's next council meeting in December.  "Two things will make women's football grow much faster in the coming years, and that is prize and compensation money from FIFA and the confederations, and transfer fees," Karlsson De Cecco said. "If the English Football Association, the German Football Association, the Swedish Football Association all receive the same amount of compensation for their women's national team as for their men's national team when they participate in the World Cup, then the associations will invest much more at the grassroots level and at the very top. "As we have seen in recent years, I also think it is crucial that clubs actually pay a little more than they intended for a player, because then you see that it is an investment, and you will have a return on that investment." That rapid development of the women's game is likely to continue through the 2027 World Cup and beyond, Karlsson De Cecco said.   "It is the fastest-growing sport in the world right now, and I don't see anything stopping it." ($1 = 10.1337 Swedish crowns)

Source: Reuters

Iceye bid for Avio gets frosty response from Italian government

FILE PHOTO: The Avio logo is seen in this illustration taken October 8, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

FAST

ROME, Nov 18 : A bid for Italy's Avio by Finnish satellite operator Iceye drew a cool initial response from the Italian government, with the defence minister urging state-controlled Leonardo to "think carefully" before selling its stake in the company. On Tuesday Iceye made a €2 billion ($2.2 billion) cash offer for Avio, with the goal of creating an integrated European space and defence group. Defence and aerospace group Leonardo holds a stake of 18 per cent in the rocket maker. The deal, part of a drive to boost European defence integration and reduce reliance on external providers such as Elon Musk's Starshield, will need a green light from the Italian government under its golden power rules to shield strategic assets. However, it remains to be seen whether and under what conditions Rome would clear the operation, as defence-related groups are seen as key to national interest by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who in the past has imposed tight limits on such deals.

Talking to Reuters ahead of a parliament session in Rome, Defence Minister Guido Crosetto - a key ally of Meloni - said Leonardo should be cautious when considering whether to sell its shares to the state-backed Finnish company. "If I were Leonardo, I would think carefully before exiting (Avio)," he said when asked whether part of the shares should remain in Italian hands to protect national interests. SENSITIVE ASSETS This year, the Italian government allowed equity firms Advent and Nextalia to take over Tinexta group on the condition that its defence arm remained in national hands. It was eventually acquired by state lender CDP. Speaking at an event in Helsinki, Iceye CEO Rafal Modrzewski said the company had held consultations with the parties involved, including governments, before launching the bid, and that it would take a few more months to close the transaction. However, a person close to the matter told Reuters that Rome had not received any formal notification regarding the Avio bid, and said it was therefore unable to assess it. A second official said the government intended to carry out all the necessary steps to assess the transaction and its implications for the national interest. The offer comes at a particularly sensitive moment for Avio, which is building up capacity in the US market through a new manufacturing plant in Virginia, which it expects to complete in late 2028. In contrast with Crosetto's cautious approach, Leonardo CEO Lorenzo Mariani said on Tuesday that he was "pleasantly surprised" by the bid. A source close to Leonardo said that the group had no contact with Iceye before it launched the bid. A second source said Leonardo would soon hold a board meeting to examine the offer. According to a note published on Wednesday by broker Equita, there was a good chance the deal could proceed, with Leonardo eventually retaining a stake to safeguard Italian presence. Avio shares traded 1.5 per cent higher on Wednesday at €39.75, below the €41 offer price. ($1 = 0.9101 euros) (Additional reporting by Elvira Pollina in Milan and Essi Lehto in HelsinkiEditing by Giulia Segreti and Keith Weir)

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米、ロシア産ウランの購入増やす見通し＝ロスアトム総裁
item.description: [モスクワ １８日 ロイター] - ロシア国営原子力企業ロスアトムのアレクセイ・リハチョフ総裁は１８日、米国は今後、ロ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米、ロシア産ウランの購入増やす見通し＝ロスアトム総裁 11/18 20:28 配信

ロスアトムのアレクセイ・リハチョフ総裁、10月30日撮影 REUTERS/Anastasia Barashkova（ロイター） [モスクワ １８日 ロイター] - ロシア国営原子力企業ロスアトムのアレクセイ・リハチョフ総裁は１８日、米国は今後、ロシア産ウランの購入を増やすことになるとの見通しを示し、ロシア・米国・中国の首脳会談を前に、この件をプーチン大統領に報告したと付け加えた。

記者団に対し、プーチン氏からロシアと米国の原子力エネルギー分野における協力状況について尋ねられたと明らかにした。

２０２４年に当時のバイデン米大統領は原子力発電所で使用される低濃縮ロシア産ウランの輸入禁止法を成立させた。ウクライナ情勢に関連して米国がロシアに科した制裁措置の一つで、同法は２８年からの全面禁止を想定し、２７年までは輸入を継続できる例外規定が含まれている。

リハチョフ氏はこれについて、「当面、われわれの協力の実際の条件は変わらない」ことを意味するが、「明らかに、この問題は議論し、解決する必要がある」と述べた。

同氏は、５０年までに新たな原子力発電所を建設するという米国の計画により、ウランに対する需要がさらに高まるだろうとし、ロシアはその需要に応えるのに最適な立場にあると指摘。「米国がわれわれと協力せずに発電容量を大幅に増やすことは極めて困難だろう。われわれは米国のパートナーとこの件について協議している」と語った。

item.description: [北京 １８日 ロイター] - 中国の騰訊控股（テンセント）が１８日発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が前年同期比８...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
テンセント、第3四半期は増収ペース鈍化　ＡＩ需要でクラウドは好調 11/18 20:27 配信

テンセントのロゴ、国際フェアのブースで2025年9月撮影 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov/File Photo（ロイター） [北京 １８日 ロイター] - 中国の騰訊控股（テンセント）が１８日発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が前年同期比８％増だった。ゲーム事業の成長が鈍化し、増収率は市場予想と前四半期の実績を下回った。

一方、人工知能（ＡＩ）サービスへの需要がクラウド事業を押し上げた。投資家はテンセントの巨額のＡＩ投資が成果を上げ始めているのか、それとも利益率を圧迫しているのかを見極めようとしており、クラウド事業の動向に注目している。

売上高は２０７３億元（３１１億ドル）で、ＬＳＥＧがまとめた予想の２１０８億元をやや下回った。前四半期の増収率は１１％だった。

クラウド部門を含むフィンテック・ビジネスサービス事業の売上高は９％増の６３７億元。ＡＩ関連のクラウドサービスへの需要が主なけん引役となった。

ゲーム事業を含む付加価値サービス事業の売上高は、３％増の９８３億元。ゲーム売上高は国内が１１％増加した一方、海外は９％減少した。

純利益は０．８％増の６３６億１０００万元と、予想の５９４億６０００万元を上回った。

設備投資額は８１４億元で、前四半期の５２８億元から増加した。上期は８４７億元となり、２０２５年通年の約７９０億元を上回った。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：中国「独身の日」、世界最大級セールでＡＩトークンが新たな目玉に アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/18(水) 20:27 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: 対中貿易協定追加交渉が妥結、娯楽・観光業界後押しへ＝韓国政府
item.description: [ソウル １８日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は１８日、中国との間で２国間自由貿易協定（ＦＴＡ）に基づくサービス・投資分野...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
対中貿易協定追加交渉が妥結、娯楽・観光業界後押しへ＝韓国政府 11/18 20:24 配信

中韓首脳会談、18日の代表撮影 ALEX PLAVEVSKI/Pool via REUTERS（ロイター） [ソウル １８日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は１８日、中国との間で２国間自由貿易協定（ＦＴＡ）に基づくサービス・投資分野の追加交渉が実質的に妥結したと発表した。娯楽・観光業界を活性化させるものとしている。

声明によると、現在約３８８億ドル規模にある両国間のサービス貿易・投資が拡大する見込み。深センで開催された中韓首脳会談で合意に至った。

韓国の金正官産業通商相は、この合意がコンテンツ、観光、金融、小売などの分野で韓国企業が中国市場に参入するための安定した政策的基盤を提供すると述べた。

声明によると、中国は韓国との貿易交渉において、映画やゲームなどの分野で初めて韓国に最恵国待遇を付与することに合意した。

また、中国は韓国のコンテンツを評価する際に非差別原則を適用することを約束した。

両国は、ドラマ、アニメ、ドキュメンタリーなどのテレビ番組の共同制作で合意した。

また、中国政府は、韓国の旅行会社が中国国内の２３地域で事業を展開できるよう認める観光協定に署名した。

米軍の地上配備型ミサイル迎撃システム（ＴＨＡＡＤ）の韓国国内への配備が中国の反発を招き、韓国の観光、化粧品、娯楽産業は１０年間にわたり中国市場で規制に直面してきた。

item.content:encoded:
米政権、国内企業に中国製ＡＩ使用状況の開示義務付けも＝関係筋 11/18 20:13 配信

米中の国旗、ホワイトハウスで9月24日撮影 REUTERS/Evan Vucci（ロイター） Alexandra Alper

[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は国内企業に対し、中国製ＡＩ（人工知能）モデルの使用状況開示を義務付けることを検討している。関係筋３人がロイターに明らかにした。

中国製ＡＩへの依存を抑制するための試みという。アリババが開発したＡＩモデル「Qwen」をＡＩカスタマーサービスエージェントとして活用している民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーのような企業は、その情報を自社のウェブサイトに掲載することが義務付けられるようになる。

ただ、この計画が政権内で支持を集めているのかどうかは現時点では明らかではない。

ホワイトハウス、財務省、アリババ、はコメント要請に応じていない。

エアビーアンドビーは声明で、「圧倒的に米国発のモデル」のＡＩを活用していると説明。また、「ごく限られた数の中国発のモデルを使用しているが、それらは全てオープンソースで、承認された米国拠点のサービスプロバイダーを通じてのみ運用し、データと運用を分離し、保護している」と述べた。

在ワシントン中国大使館は、中国政府は貿易やテクノロージー関連の問題の政治化に反対しているとし、それは「世界のAIの進歩を阻害するだけで、誰の利益にもならない」と述べた。その上で「われわれは中国企業の合法的な権利と利益を断固として擁護する」とした。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：中国「独身の日」、世界最大級セールでＡＩトークンが新たな目玉に アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/19(木) 0:38 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 18 : Shares of AI-related companies jumped on Wednesday after Nvidia's stronger-than-expected revenue forecast reassured investors about robust AI demand and the chipmaker's outlook following the exit of longtime CEO Jensen Huang. Nvidia shares rose 3.5 per cent in premarket trading after the chipmaker forecast fourth-quarter revenue at $130 billion, plus or minus 3 per cent, above analysts' consensus estimate of $125.25 billion. The company also ruled out rehiring Huang, whose shock exit last week over revelations of extramarital affairs ended three decades of founder-led control. Nvidia has been the centerpiece of the AI trade, supplying the chips that power most AI data centers, and its results are watched as a gauge of demand across the sector.

Under Huang, the company has also financed infrastructure built around its chips, a strategy that has driven demand but also raised questions about circular funding between the chipmaker and its customers. "For Nvidia, strong earnings have bought management time. For the broader AI trade, they reinforce confidence in infrastructure demand, but the next leg of the rally may depend increasingly on which companies can turn that demand into sustainable profits," said Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo. CoreWeave and Nebius Group, neocloud firms backed by Nvidia, jumped 5.4 per cent and 7 per cent, respectively. Data center-related companies Applied Digital, IREN, Core Scientific and Hut 8 also jumped between 5.3 per cent and 6.6 per cent. Chip stocks, widely regarded as among the biggest winners of the AI boom, were broadly higher. Advanced Micro Devices gained 2.9 per cent, Broadcom added 2.9 per cent and Intel climbed 1.8 per cent. Memory chipmaker Micron Technology rose 3.2 per cent, while data storage companies Western Digital and Sandisk gained 3.1 per cent and 3.6 per cent, respectively. Photonic product makers Lumentum and Coherent, along with AI server makers Dell, HPE and Super Micro, gained between 3.2 per cent and 6 per cent each. AI hyperscalers also gained modestly, with Oracle, Alphabet, Amazon.com, Meta Platforms and Microsoft up between 0.4 per cent and 2.8 per cent. Some tech and AI stocks in Japan closed higher, along with an upbeat session for South Korean tech giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The AI trade has also been tested since the Democrats' sweeping wins in the midterm elections stoked fears of tougher regulation of data center buildouts, sending the tech-heavy Nasdaq into correction territory earlier this month. The next test of the AI trade will come as Anthropic prepares to price its public offering later on Wednesday, which could value the company at as much as $1.4 trillion.

Source: Reuters

Bangladesh deploys paramilitary as unrest grows over Hasina’s return

Reuters

18 November, 2026 04:30 pm IST

By Zia Chowdhury DHAKA, Nov 18 (Reuters) – Bangladesh stepped up security and deployed hundreds of paramilitary troops nationwide on Wednesday as the planned return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has sparked clashes, bomb blasts and arson attacks blamed on supporters of her banned party.

Hasina, who has lived in exile in neighbouring India since she fled Dhaka following violent protests demanding her resignation in August 2024, has requested a new passport and identity card, saying she plans to return in December.

But the government has so far rejected her request, leading to members and supporters of her Awami League party taking to the streets in protest.

Show Full Article

Last week, the party announced a week-long programme of protests and rallies to mobilise support for Hasina’s return, culminating in a nationwide lockdown on November 19.

Police have recorded dozens of crude bomb blasts and incidents of vehicles being torched in at least 28 districts over the last 10 days, with several police personnel and civilians injured, local media has reported.

BOMBS AND ARSON

Late on Tuesday, an activist of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) was allegedly killed by unidentified people during a protest near Hasina’s home district of Gopalganj, police said.

On the same night, a crude bomb exploded outside the Dhaka residence of Cultural Affairs Minister Nitai Roy Chowdhury, and the house of a BNP lawmaker and shops belonging to BNP supporters in Gopalganj were set on fire, police added.

On Wednesday morning, a bus company helper was burnt to death in the southern district of Pirojpur after two buses were set on fire, authorities said.

Tuesday marked the day on which Hasina was sentenced to death a year ago by a local court that found her guilty of ordering a deadly crackdown on the student-led uprising against her in 2024.

GOVT BLAMES OVERSEAS AWAMI LEAGUE LEADERS

At least 37 Grameen Bank branches and offices have been targeted in arson attacks or attempted fires since November 10, with 14 more attacked since midnight on Tuesday, the bank said.

The bank was founded by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus, who led Bangladesh’s interim government after Hasina’s ouster and has faced hostility from Hasina’s supporters.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police have arrested at least 71 members of banned organisations, including the Awami League and its affiliated outfits, in the last 24 hours, police spokesperson Niaz Mehedi said.

On Tuesday, Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed said Awami League leaders abroad were inciting supporters to destabilise Bangladesh and torch property, adding that those involved in violence would be identified and prosecuted.

Awami League leaders, most of whom are in hiding, could not be reached for comment.

(Reporting by Zia Chowdhury in Dhaka; Writing by YP Rajesh; Editing by Saad Sayeed)

item.title: Brazil pushes back on EU review of Anglo American nickel deal
item.description: Brazil disputes Brussels' authority over a Chinese acquisition as Anglo American warns its two nickel mines could close.
item.dc:creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
item.content:encoded:
Brazil pushes back on EU review of Anglo American nickel deal

Staff Writer | November 18, 2026 | 3:43 am Critical Minerals   Top Companies   China   Europe   Latin America   Nickel

Barro Alto. ( Image courtesy of Anglo American | Flickr. )

Brazil has challenged the European Union’s scrutiny of Anglo American’s (LON: AAL) $500-million sale of its Brazilian nickel operations to China’s MMG (HKE: 1208), raising concerns about foreign regulators intervening in domestic mining transactions.

Brazil’s foreign ministry wrote to the European Commission, the EU’s antitrust regulator, arguing that the deal involves Brazilian assets and falls outside its jurisdiction, Reuters reported. The Commission is reviewing whether MMG could redirect ferronickel supplies from Europe to China, potentially hurting European stainless steel producers.

“If the transaction is prohibited, Anglo American will place Barro Alto and Codemin (mines) into care and maintenance, with closure as the objective. This is not a negotiating position,” Anglo American CEO Duncan Wanblad wrote last week to executives at ferronickel customers including Acerinox (BME: ACX), Aperam (AMS: APAM) and Outokumpu (HEL: OUT1V).

The dispute highlights growing tensions between national control over critical minerals and foreign competition oversight, as governments seek to protect strategic resources and industrial supply chains. Brazil has identified nickel as a priority mineral because of its economic and geopolitical importance, while European authorities are seeking to safeguard supplies for domestic manufacturers.

Sovereignty concerns

Brazil’s competition regulator, Cade, has not opposed the transaction. A European Commission spokesperson confirmed contact with Brazilian authorities but declined further comment.

Brazilian mining industry association Ibram has joined the EU investigation as an interested third party. Its head of institutional affairs, Pablo Cesario, warned that the review could set a precedent for foreign intervention in transactions involving Brazilian assets.

EU scrutiny of Anglo-MMG nickel deal tests China stance

The challenge comes as Brazil strengthens oversight of its mineral sector. The country’s newly established National Council for the Industrialization of Critical and Strategic Minerals has placed nickel among its priorities, reflecting efforts to retain greater influence over resources important to industrial development.

President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva had planned to raise the dispute with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen at a climate conference in Turkey, but the meeting did not take place.

Supply risks

MMG has offered assurances that ferronickel deliveries to European customers would continue after the acquisition, seeking to address concerns about potential supply disruptions.

The proposed takeover puts Anglo American’s efforts to divest its Brazilian nickel assets at odds with European competition concerns, leaving the future of the operations dependent on regulatory approval.

The European Commission is scheduled to decide on the transaction by Dec. 21.

(With files from Reuters)

item.title: トランプ氏が中国着、習氏は保護主義に対抗表明 米中ロ首脳会合控え
item.description:
Liz Lee Laurie Chen
[深セン（中国） １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Liz Lee　Laurie Chen

[深セン（中国） １８日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席は１８日、貿易保護主義に対抗する姿勢を示す一方、ロシアのプーチン大統領も加わる３カ国首脳会合を前に中国入りしたトランプ米大統領を温かく迎えた。

習氏は深センの空港でトランプ氏を出迎えた。国家主席就任以来、訪中した首脳を空港で出迎えるのは初めて。９月の前回会談時に、トランプ氏がワシントン郊外のアンドルーズ統合基地で習氏を出迎えたことに応えた形だ。

トランプ氏の到着に先立ち、習氏とプーチン氏は、同地で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議を前に、それぞれ踏み込んだ演説を行った。

習氏は開幕演説で「自由で開かれた貿易」への支持を呼びかけ、世界貿易機関（ＷＴＯ）を中核とするルールに基づいた多角的貿易体制を断固として守ると述べた。トランプ政権下で関税を引き上げ、外交政策で不安定な対応を取る米国とは対照的に、中国が国際社会の安定したパートナーであると印象付ける狙いとみられる。

プーチン氏は演説で、ロシアのウクライナ戦争を巡って科された西側諸国の制裁を批判した。

深センの空港では、習氏とトランプ氏が短くハグをして言葉を交わした後、それぞれの車列に向かった。

国営新華社通信によると、習氏は「中国は礼節を重んじる国で、礼には礼をもって応える伝統がある」と述べ、米中関係やアジア太平洋地域の協力、世界情勢について協議することを楽しみにしていると語った。トランプ氏は習氏との会談は毎回「非常に楽しい」と応じた。

両氏はその後、ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議の会場でプーチン氏ら各国首脳と合流。握手を交わし、集合写真撮影に臨んだ後、晩さん会に出席した。

１９日にはロシアのプーチン大統領も加わり米中ロ首脳会合を開く。ウクライナとの戦争や米国によるイランでの戦争のほか、貿易、人工知能（ＡＩ）、核兵器などの対立要因について協議する可能性がある。

この会談を巡っては、米・英・ソ連による１９４５年のヤルタ会談と比較されている。ヤルタ会談は、第２次世界大戦後の国際秩序の土台を築いた一方、大国の取り決めを小国に押し付ける体制の代名詞となった。

米政府当局者と、ロシアの通信社が伝えた同国政府高官らの発言によると、トランプ氏はプーチン氏と個別にも会談する。ロシア側の高官らは、本格的な２国間交渉は予定していないと述べた。

ロシアのインタファクス通信は、ウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交担当）の発言として、プーチン氏と習氏が３カ国首脳会合について協議したと報じた。ロシアの通信社によると、ペスコフ大統領報道官は３カ国会合には１時間が割り当てられていると述べた。

今回の米中ロ会談は欧州やアジアの一部政府にも不安を与えている。世界有数の軍事大国が他国の利益を顧みないのではないかと懸念されている。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 18 : NASA's Voyager 1 probe is believed to have now hit a distance milestone accomplished by no other spacecraft from Earth, based on advance computations by the US space agency, as the probe ventures through the near-emptiness of interstellar space. The robotic probe, launched in 1977, was calculated by NASA to have reached a light-day from Earth, the distance that light travels in 24 hours — about 16 billion miles (26 billion km) — on Wednesday at 5:16 a.m. ET (1016 GMT). Officials at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in California will have to wait about a day to get a signal from the probe, confirming it has reached this distance. They have scheduled an event for Thursday to discuss the milestone. "Reaching one light-day is an astounding feat, one that I never expected to see," Voyager project manager Suzanne Dodd said.

Voyager 1, the most distant human-made object, is flying at almost 38,000 miles per hour (61,000 kph). It crossed the outer edge of the heliosphere, a protective bubble of particles and magnetic fields produced by the sun, to enter interstellar space in 2012. Its twin, Voyager 2, was also launched in 1977 and entered interstellar space in 2018. A Jet Propulsion Laboratory representative said recent power-saving measures could give the two Voyager spacecraft enough power to stay in communication with Earth for three to four more years. "But the goal of the mission is to do science, and there is enough power to keep the current suite of instruments going through the 50th launch anniversary next year. Beyond that is hard to predict, and of course these are nearly 50-year-old spacecraft, and there are always things the team cannot anticipate that might happen," the JPL representative said. Voyager 1 journeyed past Jupiter and Saturn, the solar system's two largest planets, earlier in its mission. It continues to gather scientific data. For instance, its instruments have detected the faint monotonous hum caused by the constant vibrations of the small amounts of gas present in interstellar space. "Voyager is sending back continuous measurements of magnetic fields, cosmic rays and of plasma waves that we receive on Earth whenever the Deep Space Network points its antenna at Voyager," Dodd said. The Deep Space Network is NASA's international array of giant radio antennas supporting interplanetary spacecraft missions. "After the heliopause crossing, the magnetic field direction did not rotate into the interstellar direction as expected, but has maintained the direction it had when both Voyagers crossed the heliopause, a direction governed by our sun. We are watching to see when that rotation might occur," Dodd said. "We also are still observing effects from our sun, including strong solar storms like coronal mass ejections, that generate shocks and pressure fronts that reach as far away as Voyager 1 and beyond," Dodd said. "Where does the sun's influence end and pristine interstellar space begin? Perhaps Voyager may last long enough to answer that question."

Source: Reuters

Wall Street prepares for Anthropic IPO frenzy, despite broader AI stock slump

FILE PHOTO: An Anthropic logo is displayed at Moscone Center during the Dreamforce 2026 technology summit in San Francisco, California, US, September 17, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo

18 Nov 2026 06:07PM (Updated: 18 Nov 2026 11:51PM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 18 : Wall Street, expecting that wealthy investors and retail buyers will battle for shares of Anthropic, is rolling out products tied to the stock, hosting client events and giving away merchandise ahead of the AI company's potentially record launch.  Despite the steep losses among the hyperscalers and other stocks linked to the AI trade in recent weeks, there is building anticipation from these investors for the Anthropic initial public offering, which is expected on Thursday.  The IPO is expected to value the company, which created the Claude chatbot, at up to $1.4 trillion. But it has a hard act to follow after the SpaceX launch, earlier this year, created a frenzy of excitement and events.  "Judging by the number of people interacting with us and asking us about this, and filling out forms, this could be even bigger than SpaceX," said Will Rhind, founder of GraniteShares, who plans to launch a 2x bull Anthropic exchange-traded fund along with a 2x bear product next week.

A successful IPO could boost confidence in other AI-related stocks, including many of the largest technology companies that have powered the stock market rally to a series of record highs, even as shares have recently swung sharply amid questions over the industry's ability to generate measurable profits.  According to industry estimates based on regulatory filings, the market was preparing in coming days for at least 11 leveraged single-stock ETFs from seven issuers, with retail investors accounting for much of the interest.   One advertisement, on the StockTwits investing social media website, read: "Artificial intelligence meets human conviction with the 2X Long Anthropic Daily ETF from Tradr. Coming soon!"  "It’s going to hinge on the bull/bear case for AI," said Rhind. "The believers are not going to be put off by this volatility in the broader AI trade."  Vanda Research, which tracks retail trading activity, said it expects Anthropic itself to attract about $250 million in net retail buying, based on its analysis of activity on listing days and the volume of the company's pre-IPO perpetual futures traded on Hyperliquid. Such a level would double the record $118 million of retail buying for the SpaceX IPO.  Karl Cheong, head of ETFs at Ninepoint Partners in Toronto, points to the selloff in bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies as a sign that retail investors want to raise cash to buy Anthropic. "This will be the first frontier model that retail investors can access easily on a public market," he said. Ninepoint plans to launch an ETF for Canadian investors that would combine leveraged exposure to Anthropic, with a covered call strategy generating income.  WEALTH CLIENTS, LIVESTREAMS, MERCH  Banks have also planned select events. Goldman Sachs organized a launch event on Tuesday for its wealth clients that was attended by the bank's president, John Waldron, as well as Anthropic Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao and its co-founder and president, Daniela Amodei, according to a person familiar with the matter.  JPMorgan plans to livestream the IPO for clients and has prepared merchandise such as t-shirts and laptop covers, according to another person familiar with the matter. Anthropic Chief Executive Dario Amodei and his team were at the bank's offices all day on Friday meeting investors, the person said. Anthropic declined to comment on the two events. Still, not everyone is jumping on the bandwagon.  London-based Ben Preston, responsible for the Orbis Global Equity Strategy, a long-only stock-picking fund which also has a retail investor base, said the fund will not be buying Anthropic at the IPO. “If it comes in at an IPO value of whatever it is – one and a half trillion dollars – that is a very expensive valuation to pay for a company which is unproven," said Preston.  Although StockTwits users give the anticipated IPO an "extremely bullish" score of 85 out of 100, based on a poll on its site, 67 per cent of the more than 18,000 members who responded said they did not plan to buy Anthropic during the initial offering. Only 20 per cent said they will buy, while another 13 per cent said they would wait to see the price.  Some on social media were skeptical about the potential price of the listing. Others said it has been tougher for ordinary investors to get their hands on pre-IPO shares of Anthropic than for SpaceX shares before the latter's IPO in June.  SpaceX has since had a mixed record, with shares priced at $135 in the IPO, jumping to $150 then briefly as high as $225, before dropping as low as $104. They now trade around $142. Still, "as it has gotten closer to (Anthropic's) launch date, I've seen the excitement and the clamor to get a piece of whatever is allocated to retail grow and grow," said Mitchell Caplan, chairman and CEO of Willow Wealth and former CEO of E-Trade Financial.  OVERSEAS INTEREST  Interest has also been building abroad, with many British platforms inviting retail investors to send orders for shares. “Historically, retail investors have been on the sidelines when it comes to public listings," said Jordan Sinclair, president of Robinhood UK. Yet Susannah Streeter, chief investment strategist at Wealth Club, a British investment platform serving high-net-worth investors, said the IPO highlights the divide between connected buyers who can get in pre-IPO and retail investors who end up pleading with their brokers for part of an allocation.  "It's a bit like arriving at a glamorous launch party – institutional backers on the VIP guest list gain early entry, enjoying the vintage champagne and finest canapés behind closed doors," Streeter said in an email. "By the time the doors finally open to the general public, the risk is that the best of the festivities are well underway and latecomers are left paying a steep entry fee to pick over the flat prosecco and leftover crisps."

Source: Reuters

item.title: エヌビディア、中国への高性能ＡＩ半導体出荷停止 先行き不透明に
item.description:
Eduardo Baptista
[深圳（中国） １８日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアのコレット・クレス暫...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディア、中国への高性能ＡＩ半導体出荷停止　先行き不透明に 11/18 18:47 配信

エヌビディアのロゴと中国国旗。2025年8月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Eduardo Baptista

[深圳（中国） １８日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアのコレット・クレス暫定最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、中国への高性能人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体の出荷を停止したと明らかにした。米政府による特別輸出許可の先行きが不透明になっている。

先週辞任したジェンスン・フアン氏の後任となったクレス氏は１７日の決算説明会で、１０月２５日までの四半期に、輸出許可を受けた「ホッパー」世代のデータセンター向け製品を中国に２４億ドル販売したと表明。ただ、現時点で追加出荷の計画はないと説明した。

クレス氏は「当社の業績見通しには、輸出許可を受けたホッパー世代のデータセンター向け製品を一切織り込んでおらず、これらの製品の中国向け出荷も既に停止している」と述べた。

出荷を停止した理由や、停止が恒久的なものになるかどうかは説明しなかった。

ホッパー製品群には、高度なＡＩモデルの学習や実行に使われる高性能プロセッサー「Ｈ２００」が含まれる。

＜米政府の輸出規制＞

米国は２０２２年に半導体の輸出規制を導入、その後、中国への制限を強化した。しかし、トランプ大統領は２５年の習近平国家主席との首脳会談後、承認された中国の顧客へのＨ２００の販売を認めると表明していた。

米国は２６年１月、Ｈ２００の輸出許可方針を緩和、安全保障上の条件を満たすことを前提に、輸出申請を個別に審査することを認めた。この決定に先立ち、フアン氏は数カ月にわたり働きかけを続けていた。

Ｈ２００は、世界最大の半導体受託生産会社である台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）が台湾でエヌビディア向けに製造している。

ロイターのこれまでの報道によると、米政府はアリババ、騰訊控股（テンセント）、動画投稿アプリ「ＴｉｋＴｏｋ」を運営するバイトダンスなど中国企業１０社へのＨ２００の販売を承認した。

ただ、中国政府はその後、Ｈ２００の輸入を制限した。中国企業はＡＩ計算能力への需要拡大に直面しているが、米国の技術への依存低減を目指している。

ロイターは今月、中国政府が大規模な輸入を承認しなかったため、約６０万個のＨ２００が中国本土への出荷を待って香港で保管されていると報じた。

また、関係筋の話として、中国の複数の大手インターネット企業がここ数カ月で、それぞれ約１万個のＨ２００を入手したと報じた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：中国「独身の日」、世界最大級セールでＡＩトークンが新たな目玉に アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/18(水) 18:47 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Xi urges open trade, Putin criticises sanctions as Trump lands in China
item.description: Xi Jinping defended free trade while Vladimir Putin criticised Western sanctions at the APEC summit, as Donald Trump arrived in China ahead of a high-stakes trilateral meeting on Thursday.
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / Xi urges open trade, Putin criticises sanctions as Trump lands in China

Xi urges open trade, Putin criticises sanctions as Trump lands in China Xi Jinping defended free trade while Vladimir Putin criticised Western sanctions at the APEC summit, as Donald Trump arrived in China ahead of a high-stakes trilateral meeting on Thursday.

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin criticised Western trade policies and sanctions at the APEC summit, as US President Donald Trump arrived in China ahead of high-stakes talks with both leaders.| Image: PTI

Reuters 5 min read Last Updated : Nov 18 2026 | 11:07 PM IST

Listen to This Article

China's President Xi Jinping on Wednesday pledged to stand up against trade protectionism, while his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin criticised Western sanctions as the two set the stage for a high-stakes trilateral meeting with US President Donald Trump.   They delivered their speeches at an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the southern Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, hours before Trump landed in China after meeting key regional allies in Manila this week.   Xi greeted Trump at the airport, the first time he had done so with any visiting leader since becoming president, reciprocating his counterpart's gesture at Joint Base Andrews in September when they last met. They briefly hugged and exchanged words before walking to their motorcades.

"China is a country of etiquette and has a tradition of reciprocating courtesy," Xi was quoted as saying by state news agency Xinhua. He added he was looking forward to discussing China-US relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation and the global landscape.   Trump said every meeting with Xi has been "very pleasant," Xinhua reported. Also Read

They then joined Putin and other leaders at the APEC summit venue for handshakes, a group photo and banquet.   The three men will meet on the sidelines on Thursday and potentially discuss Russia's war with Ukraine and the US war in Iran, as well as other flashpoints such as trade, AI and nuclear weapons.

The meeting has drawn comparisons with the 1945 Yalta Conference between the US, Britain and the Soviet Union that formalised spheres of influence, set the stage for the post-World War Two order and became shorthand for great-power deals imposed on smaller countries.   It has also unnerved some European and Asian capitals, which fear the world's greatest military powers will disregard their interests.   In his opening address, Xi urged support for what he called "free and open trade", trying to portray his country as a stable partner on the global stage, in contrast with the US, which has raised tariffs and adopted a more muscular foreign policy under Trump.

MESSAGE RESONATES WITH GLOBAL SOUTH   Xi's remarks came after Washington announced further restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips from companies such as Nvidia, which could further complicate a fragile trade truce with Beijing. China has pledged to retaliate.   "We must firmly uphold the rules-based multilateral trading system with the World Trade Organization at its core, support free and open trade and investment," Xi told an audience of business executives.   Western trade partners have criticised China for running annual trade surpluses exceeding $1 trillion through policies that support its manufacturing sector at the expense of its consumers.   Beijing says its growth model is appropriate for an economy still catching up with the world's richest, but Washington, Brussels and others are concerned about China's supply chain dominance providing the country with geopolitical leverage and say its policies threaten their industries and jobs.

Xi said China will continue to invest in its industrial complex and new technologies. The world's second-largest economy will lower tariffs and further open up its markets, while standing up against protectionism and unilateralism, he added.   His "message is likely to resonate with many Global South countries and reinforces Beijing's effort to contrast its technology strategy with that of Washington," said George Chen, partner and chair of digital practice at The Asia Group.   Trump's trip to Asia is his first since his Republican Party's defeat in midterm elections, while allegations involving Nvidia founder Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy add to the tension.

COLD RECEPTION FOR TAKAICHI   Leaders from Australia, Canada, South Korea and others were met by dancers and soldiers hoisting rifles.   Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi was instead shown to a car after landing without any welcoming ceremony. Her visit to China comes amid a rift between Beijing and Tokyo that began a year ago after she said Japan could deploy its military if a Chinese move on Taiwan also threatened its territory.   On Tuesday, Taiwan and Japan flagged incursions by Russian aircraft into their airspace.   Putin, who was speaking after Ukraine crippled the vital Kerch road bridge linking Crimea to Russia in a major blow to his four-year-old war, followed Xi on stage with a speech that described Western powers as "former hegemons." He said Europe was in a "humiliating decline" and that anti-Russian sanctions imposed after his invasion of Ukraine had backfired.

"Experience has shown that the traditional tools of economic dominance and de facto coercion have largely run their course, having lost much of their intimidating power," Putin said.   "While sanctions, tariffs, and export restrictions may still exert a certain deterrent effect, they are incapable of halting growth — let alone crushing the economies of competitors."   In Manila, Trump vowed to deepen defence cooperation with the Philippines, amid its growing friction with Beijing over disputed features in the South China Sea. Earlier, he floated the possibility of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong Un in China, but that has not been confirmed.   The Kremlin this week dismissed comparisons with the Yalta Conference as "games of political scientists," but said the meeting will have a major impact on global affairs. Beijing said the trilateral will promote world peace.

Putin described the world as "turbulent" but said disagreements can be addressed by "sitting at the table."   "I therefore expect big potential benefit from the upcoming trilateral meeting," he said.

item.title: ＥＣＢ、仏など高債務国に歳出抑制促す 介入には否定的 金融安定報告
item.description: [フランクフルト １８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は、フランスなど債務の多い国に対し、歳出を抑制しなければ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ、仏など高債務国に歳出抑制促す　介入には否定的　金融安定報告 11/18 18:36 配信

フランクフルトにある欧州中央銀行（ECB）の本部。2023年3月撮影。 REUTERS/Heiko Becker（ロイター） [フランクフルト １８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は、フランスなど債務の多い国に対し、歳出を抑制しなければ借り入れコストの一段の上昇に直面すると警告した。各国政府に財政規律を促す上で市場が重要な役割を果たし得るとの見解を示し、ＥＣＢとして介入を急がない姿勢を示唆した。

国内政治が混乱する中、フランスは巨額の財政赤字を抑制できないでいる。投資家はフランス国債への投資にますます大きな上乗せ金利を求めており、債務の持続可能性への懸念が高まっている。

エコノミストの間ではＥＣＢによる市場の下支えが必要になるかどうかが議論されている。ＥＣＢは、特定の加盟国を支援することは自らの役割ではないとして、介入論には一貫して否定的な姿勢を示してきた。

ＥＣＢは１８日公表した金融安定報告で「長期的な視点に立てば、市場による規律は、慎重な財政政策や適時の政策修正を促す価格シグナルを出すことにより、脆弱性の抑制に役立ち得る」と指摘した。

一方でリスクも認め、特にフランスに言及した。同国国債の信用スプレッド拡大は同国固有の問題を浮き彫りにしており、２０２７年の大統領選に絡む政治リスクも一因となっている。

＜財政再建の重要性高まる＞

ＥＣＢは、投資家の懸念が借り入れコストを押し上げ、それが財政を一段と脆弱にし、さらなる投資家離れを招きかねないことが主な問題だと指摘。

「財政再建は既に着手すべき時期を過ぎており、国債市場で、ニュースに敏感に反応しレバレッジを活用する投資家の存在感が増す中、その重要性は一段と高まっている」とした。

欧州委員会によると、フランスの債務残高は年央時点で国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比１１９％と、ユーロ圏ではギリシャ、イタリアに次いで３番目に高かった。２０２６年の財政赤字はＧＤＰ比５．５％と、ユーロ圏２１カ国で最も高くなる見通しだ。

ＥＣＢは、フランス経済の基礎的条件（ファンダメンタルズ）が安定を保ったとしても、資金調達環境はなお厳しさを増し、脆弱性が高まると警告した。

海外投資家やヘッジファンドによるユーロ圏債の購入が増える中、新たなリスクが生じている。ＥＣＢは「海外投資家は市場にストレスがかかる局面で資金を引き揚げやすい傾向がある」と指摘。「ユーロ圏国債市場で、ヘッジファンドのように景気循環に追随する傾向が強く、多くの場合、高いレバレッジを活用する投資家の存在感が増していることも、各国の信用リスクに対する評価の急変を増幅させる可能性がある」と分析した。

＜ヘッジファンドが債券売りに拍車＞

ただＥＣＢは今年の債券売りについて、レバレッジを活用して国債に投資していたヘッジファンドが売却を余儀なくされたことで、拍車がかかったと認識している。

ＥＣＢのブイチッチ副総裁は金融安定報告の発表に際し、記者団に「スプレッドが急速に拡大した局面では、ヘッジファンドの動きがその原因になっていたことが確認された」と指摘。「長くは続かず、市場は速やかに正常化した。ただ、今回の報告で指摘したように、ヘッジファンドが急速にポジションを解消すると、市場に極めて短時間で影響が及ぶ可能性がある」と語った。

報告によると、金利スワップなどユーロ圏市場の主要な分野で、わずか５つのヘッジファンドが取引を支配していた。その活動の実態は把握しにくく、ケイマン諸島に拠点を置く事業体を利用する傾向があったという。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＥＣＢ「予防的」追加利上げへ、米イラン紛争長期化で 焦点：仏、財政赤字巡り政局緊迫　大統領選控え市場の不安と格下げ警戒 アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 アングル：ＡＩの経済金融への影響、ＥＣＢフォーラムで希望と懸念が交錯 アングル：金融市場はＥＣＢのタカ派化見込む、イラン戦による油価高騰で 11/18(水) 21:21 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株16カ月ぶり安値付近、ＡＩ関連に売り 香港株下落
item.description: [上海 １８日 ロイター] - 中国株は１６カ月ぶりの安値付近で推移し、香港株は下落した。米ハイテク規制が強化される...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株16カ月ぶり安値付近、ＡＩ関連に売り　香港株下落 11/18 18:22 配信

[上海 １８日 ロイター] - 中国株は１６カ月ぶりの安値付近で推移し、香港株は下落した。米ハイテク規制が強化される兆しが見られる中、ＡＩ（人工知能）ハードウエア輸出企業やＡＩハイパースケーラーの売りが続いた。

ガベカル・リサーチの創業パートナー、ルイバンサン・ガべ氏はリポートで「米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の問題はＡＩセクターをはるかに超えた影響を及ぼす可能性がある」と述べた。

ＣＳＩ３００指数と上海総合指数は一時０．７％下落したが、その後下落分を取り戻し、ほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。

光通信モジュールメーカー、新易盛（イーオプトリンク）は１．１％下落し、５営業日続落。同業の中際旭創は１年ぶりの安値圏。両社とも収益の大部分を米国から得ており、株価は最高値から７０％以上下落している。

香港のハンセン・テック指数は０．６％下落し、２年余りぶりの安値を記録した。

ＡＩモデル開発のミニマックスは一時過去最安値を記録。アリババは９営業日続落し、２０２５年初頭以来の安値を記録した。テンセントも２２カ月ぶりの安値まで下落した。

金関連株は米利上げ観測が強まったことを受けて４％急落した。

item.title: バイナンス、アジア5市場への進出計画
item.description:
Rae Wee
[シンガポール １８日 ロイター] - 暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業で世界最大手のバイナンスは２０２７...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
バイナンス、アジア5市場への進出計画 11/18 17:58 配信

バイナンスのロゴ。10月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Rae Wee

[シンガポール １８日 ロイター] - 暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業で世界最大手のバイナンスは２０２７年、アジアの５市場に進出する計画だと、同社の地域事業責任者が明らかにした。南アジアと東南アジアを候補地として重視しているという。バイナンスは先月、過去最大となる６３億ドル相当のデジタル資産が盗まれる被害に遭ったばかり。

アジア太平洋地域責任者のＳＢ・セケル氏は１８日、「シンガポール・フィンテック・フェスティバル」の合間、ロイターに対して「少なくとも５、６市場と協議を進めている。このうち３市場では協議がかなり進んだ段階にある」と述べた。「その他の市場とも協議を続けている」とした。

バイナンスは現在、１０を超える国・地域で営業認可を取得している。セケル氏は進出を検討している新たな市場を明らかにしなかったが、２７年第１・四半期に計画の詳細を順次公表する見通しだと述べた。

セケル氏は、デジタル資産が盗まれた事件について、バイナンスは事件発生から３６─４８時間以内に、日本、韓国、オーストラリア、タイ、ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）などの規制当局に連絡したと説明。影響の規模や攻撃の経緯に関する質問に対応したと述べた。

楽天証券、投資信託の移管手数料を当面無料に 11/18 17:55 配信

楽天のロゴ。2025年10月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［東京　１８日　ロイター］ - 楽天証券は１８日、他の金融機関への投資信託の移管手数料を当面の間無料にすると発表した。通常は１銘柄当たり３３００円（税込み）の事務手数料がかかるが、１８日受付分から無料化する。

楽天証は１７日、不正アクセスにより顧客情報の一部が漏えいした可能性があり、最大約４４７万口座で氏名、勤務先や出金先口座、年収・金融資産などを含む情報が対象になったと発表した。

FAST

BEIJING, Nov 18 : Tencent Holdings reported third-quarter revenue growth of 8 per cent on Wednesday, slowing from 11 per cent in the previous quarter as gaming growth cooled, even as demand for artificial intelligence services lifted its cloud business. For the three months ending in September, the Chinese technology giant reported revenue of 207.34 billion yuan ($31.10 billion), falling short of analyst estimates of 210.77 billion yuan, according to LSEG data. Net profit rose 0.8 per cent from the period a year ago to 63.61 billion yuan ($9.54 billion), beating analyst expectations of 59.46 billion yuan. ($1 = 6.6659 Chinese yuan renminbi)
